claire-cs: Quick check-in for Vega private deployment. Current blockers: KMS key not granting our role, customer asks which exact egress ranges we need, and audit events not indexed. Need owners + short ETAs.

ben-netops: Looking at their VPC, outbound is wide open but they want minimal changes. We need two CIDRs: 10.150.0.0/16 for egress proxies and 10.150.10.0/24 for health checks. Also recommend a static NAT for the jump host.

tessa-engr: Health-check ports: TCP 8080 (app), TCP 9100 (metrics). Splunk HF ingest is TCP 9997. Canary will require outbound to splunk host and PutObject to audit S3.

sam-kms: KMS note: their key policy doesn't include arn:aws:iam::888999000:role/redwood-service-role causing kms:Decrypt failures. Minimal policy statement to add: allow Encrypt, Decrypt, GenerateDataKey for that role. I'll DM a snippet.

ana-cust: Splunk endpoint is splunk.vega.internal:9997 (TCP). Temp NAT IP 198.51.100.21. Creating bucket now; will DM ARN + role.

ben-netops: Once we have the NAT IP I'll update SGs to allow the two CIDRs and whitelist the jump NAT. ETA ~90m after they confirm.

infra-bot: canary-preview:vega-priv passed in staging after policy applied in test; KMS decrypt OK. CI: https://ci.redwood/vega/42

sam-kms: Sent minimal policy snippet via DM. After they apply, please notify and I'll re-run decrypt/rotation tests.

claire-cs: Actions: ben -> apply SG/nat mapping; sam -> validate KMS after policy; tessa -> prepare canary runbook and rollback; ana -> DM bucket ARN and confirm Splunk open. Also flagging renewal owner since customer timeline is tight if cutover slips >5 days.

ana-cust: Policy applied, bucket arn: arn:aws:s3:::vega-redwood-audit-prod. Sent DM with role names.

claire-cs: Thanks all. Tessa, canary window tomorrow 09:00-09:30 PST? I'll post invite and runbook.

tessa-engr: Confirmed. I'll run canary and watch KPM/latency. Revert plan: traffic shift back to staging and rollback flag --rollback-to=staging. Will post results to #eng-oncall.

claire-cs: Closing loop and updating onboarding tracker. If anything blocks the canary, escalate to CS lead. :white_check_mark:
